sinopsis.es: Manuel quiere vender su cosecha de maíz para costear el viaje a la ciudad y dejar la vereda de sus padres ancianos. Conocer a Ezequiel —un viejo ermitaño y huaquero que parece haber hallado algo grande— lo enfrenta a su ambición, el amor y sus anhelos más profundos.
sinopsis.en: Manuel wants to sell his corn harvest to fund his trip to the city and leave the hamlet where his elderly parents live. Meeting Ezequiel —an old hermit and treasure-hunting huaquero who seems to have found something big— forces him to confront his ambition, love and his deepest longings.
